question: Expose arbitrary legacy logs through tool/report?
decision: Preserve bounded32KiB sanitized log RPC for debugging; never include log contents in reports/tool outputs; metadata_only optional

question: Remote active jobs consume legacy global concurrency slot?
decision: Yes, preserve single scheduler/job slot. Exclude remote queued from local launch; do not turn starting/running remote into local interruptions.

question: Catalog or epoch changes after submit?
decision: Refuse old ID, no silent manifest or authorization regeneration. Same immutable identity only.

question: How avoid old sanitizer quadratic matching on long identifier?
decision: Candidate negative identifier-boundary lookbehind avoids restarting greedy prefix at every character; same credential families. Local performance/regression tests only.
